turns.text: Hi, can you tell me when my order will arrive? It is still being made, I think.
Hello, I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
The order is SC-3188 and the email is helen.crowe@example.com. It ships to Berlin.

Thank you, Helen. Your order SC-3188 (Blue Stair, 30x40 cm) is currently in production. Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days. Our order record does not show a delivery date yet, so I cannot give you an exact arrival date. Once it ships, the tracking link will be on the order. Is there anything else I can help with?

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.
